answer.title: Daily Appointment Reminder Calls
answer.trigger: Triggers every working day at 15:00 to prepare afternoon reminder calls.
steps: Fetch today's upcoming appointments from the jobs system.
Generate a polite reminder script for each client.
Queue the automated reminder calls or prepare the call list on the phone.
Log the call status in the system after completion.
answer.ai_help: Drafting the friendly reminder message or generating the call script.
answer.risk_reason: Making a mistake simply results in an incorrect or missed reminder call to a client.
